approaches.name: Every buy and sell pair
approaches.intuition: Try each buy day with each later sell day and keep the largest difference.
steps: Track the maximum of `prices[j] - prices[i]`, never below 0

approaches.name: One pass with the cheapest price so far
approaches.intuition: The best profit ending today is today's price minus the lowest price before it. Carry that minimum forward.
steps: Keep the lowest price seen so far
pitfalls: Selling before buying: update the minimum after computing today's profit.
Falling prices: the answer is 0, not a negative number.

talkTrackMd: Frame it as: for every sell day I want the lowest earlier price. That is a running minimum, so a single pass suffices. Mention the all-decreasing case returning 0.
